about: Real IKEA US products. Every number is read from the source_url page by data/fetch_ikea.py (URLs in data/sources.txt) at fetched_at. Inches. dims_in w=width, d=depth/length, h=height; round items use the diameter for w and d. packages_in: one box per package (Width->w, Length->d, Height->h). price_usd is the price shown on the page that day and may be a temporary IKEA Family price; null if the page showed none. image_url is IKEA's main product photo, image_urls all photos on the page. rating/review_count are IKEA's customer reviews (1-5) shown on the page; color and material are IKEA's labels. dims_raw keeps every measurement the page listed.
